previous_statement: Because delta>0 and tau=sqrt(delta), tau>0; because c>0, c*tau>0. By 1.1, X_f:=H-d_f is nonnegative for all f in F_v.
new_statement: Because delta>0 and tau=sqrt(delta), tau>0; because c>0, c*tau>0. Also, with C=conv{p_w : w in W} and d_i=dist_1(p_i,C), the fact that v is a hidden top vertex of height H gives d_i<=H for every row i; hence X_f:=H-d_f is nonnegative for every f in F_v.
